title: Explicit abelian Zariski cohomology map of a module h-map
statement: For g:Y→X and a module h-map phi:F→g_*G, forget scalars sectionwise to obtain moduleAbelianHMap. Define zariskiModuleHMap between CoherentEtale.Source groups by the exact abelian inverse-image Ext map, using the canonical constant-integer comparison, followed by the cohomology map of the adjoint of moduleAbelianHMap. Use HasExt.standard in universe u+1 on both sites. This is a construction, independent of module resolution choices and etale comparisons. Notions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison].

proof.text: Forget the scalars on every component of phi; its presheaf naturality proves the abelian sheaf morphism naturality. The open inverse-image functor is flat and its abelian sheaf pullback preserves finite limits and colimits. Use its constant-sheaf comparison for Sheaf.H.mapFunctor, then Sheaf.H.map of the adjoint coefficient morphism. Compose the additive maps.
